Subject: Discovery recap + proposed 30m demo windows — SlateBridge

Hi Samira — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps from our side:

- What we heard: SlateBridge needs a low-latency inference path for document parsing + a clear retention and access-control story for PII-sensitive workloads. You emphasized throughput for peak ingestion and the ability to pin a model version for auditability.
- Open questions: expected peak concurrency, preferred KMS (Azure Key Vault vs. AWS KMS), and whether you need an on-prem option for the initial pilot.

To keep momentum, can we book a 30-minute product demo / technical deep dive with the stakeholders you mentioned? Here are three time options in PT (please pick one or suggest alternatives):

1) Tue Oct 6, 2026 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT
2) Wed Oct 7, 2026 — 9:00–9:30 AM PT
3) Mon Oct 5, 2026 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT

Suggested attendees (we recommend 2–3):
- SlateBridge: VP Eng (Ben Thompson), Solutions Architect (Mira Patel)
- Redwood: Alex Martinez (AE), Rishi Malhotra (Sales Engineer)

Attachment: SLATE-Discovery-Notes.pdf (1 page) — brief notes from today.

Proposed 30-min agenda:
- 0–5m quick recap & success criteria
- 5–20m live demo focused on inference latency and ops tools
- 20–30m Q&A + next steps (pilot scope & timeline)

Would you like us to include a short privacy/compliance slide if your security team will join?

Thanks — I’ll hold the three times until I hear back.

Best,
Alex Martinez
